verdict.rationale: GitHub's own Copilot page states that individual subscribers can opt out of having their data used for AI model training at any time, which directly delivers the story. Community skepticism about enterprise training use is not a concrete counter-example, so it lowers confidence but does not create a dispute. missing for 10: details on how the opt-out works and what data it covers, the training posture for Business/Enterprise plans, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Individual subscribers can opt out of having their data used for AI model training at any time
